notes.title: Start your engines for the Summer 2024 Update!
notes.notes:
After about 6 months of silence in the garages, I proudly present the big [i][b]Summer 2024 Update[/b][/i] for Flat Spot! Brace yourselves for improvements, new content, and even less bugs!

[list]
[*] Improve the look of your car with [b]6[/b] new livery styles! [i](The other teams are also looking sharp!)[/i]
[*] Some [b]Drivers may leave their AI teams[/b] to get their chance to drive your car! [i](Silly season is real in Flat Spot)[/i]
[*] The UI received a small overhaul, it has animations now! [i](Revolutionary, I know)[/i]
[*] Races now end with a bit of a sparkle now! [i](You'll get it once you see it!)[/i]
[*] You are finally able to cancel pit stops, in case you rethink your strategy. [i](Please don't ask why that feature took so long)[/i]
[/list]

Some smaller changes include:

[list]
[*] Off-Track events are fixed, along with some new events added.
[*] Engines are now muted while pausing the game mid-race.
[*] All combinations of Special Abilities are working as intended now.
[/list]

After the release and the first month of bug fixing I took a break from working on Flat Spot, as I felt a bit burnt out. I want to take this opportunity now, almost exactly 6 months after the last update, to once again [b]thank all of you[/b] from the bottom of my heart for playing the game, it means the world to me. As always, if you find any bugs, don't hesitate to contact me here on Steam, via mail or on instagram ([u]@flatspotgame[/u]). And of course consider leaving a review, so undecided player have references to play!

See you all out on track!
